Product Features

  • The high-quality textured corduroy fabric combines a pleasantly soft feel with an elegant look. The unique texture gives your living space a warm, inviting atmosphere and at the same time brings modern sophistication to your home.
  • The spacious 3-seater construction offers plenty of space for family, friends or relaxed movie nights. The wide seat and stable structure create a comfortable, social focal point in the living area.
  • The modular units can be flexibly adapted to your living situation – whether as a large corner sofa, L-shape or individual seating modules. You design your sofa according to your needs and room size.
  • The integrated cup holder in the armrest module ensures that drinks are always safe and within reach. Ideal for movie nights, gaming sessions or relaxed reading.
  • The side storage pocket allows you to conveniently store remote controls, tablets, magazines or other everyday items to keep everything neat and accessible at all times.
  • With its modern lines and warm fabric structure, the sofa blends harmoniously into various living concepts – ideal for living rooms, apartments, office lounges or family rooms.
